content.text:
ESLint passes now.

Cause: `eslint.config.js` imports `@eslint/css` and `@typescript-eslint/parser`, but neither was a declared root devDependency — they only resolved via pnpm hoisting, which the Vite+ 0.3.1 upgrade stopped providing. Both were already in the workspace catalog, so I added them to [package.json](package.json) devDependencies and ran `vp install`.
